articles.summary: MeiraGTx to receive up to $375 million in non-dilutive cash and up to $25 million in equity investment Following regulatory approval, Oberland Capital to receive low single-digit capped royalties on the net sales of each of AAV2-hAQP1 for the treatment of grade 2/3 late radiation-induced xerostomia
articles.title: MeiraGTx Announces $400 million Strategic Investment by Oberland Capital to Support Development and Commercialization of AAV2-hAQP1 and Botaretigene Sparoparvovec (bota-vec)
